name: qcad-mcp
description: 2D CAD operations via QCAD — floor plans, DXF conversion, SVG preview, STL extrusion, architecture analysis, structural beam analysis, and natural-language CAD workflows

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Core ezdxf ops via op discriminator: info, to_svg, extrude, stack, obj, glb, drawings, export, analyse, create, depot

tools.name: plan_edit
tools.description: Edit ops: convert (DWG<->DXF via QCAD Pro), modify (layers/entities)

tools.name: plan_annotate
tools.description: Annotation ops: dimension, measure, text, hatch, block_insert, array, wall_data, beam_analysis

tools.name: plan_pro
tools.description: QCAD Pro ops: script (ECMAScript), render (hi-fi export), exec (quick snippet)

tools.name: plan_library
tools.description: Library ops: blocks, blocks_download, scripts_search, scripts_download

tools.name: plan_ai
tools.description: AI ops: generate (NL floor plan), agentic (NL workflow), transpile (AutoLISP), sampling (host LLM reason)

tools.name: qcad
tools.description: Server ops: status (QCAD Pro install), help (tool catalog), shutdown (orderly exit)

prompts.name: cad_expert
prompts.description: Get CAD expertise and tool guidance

prompts.name: cad_analyse_plan
prompts.description: Analyse a DXF floor plan step by step

prompts.name: cad_extrude_3d
prompts.description: Extrude a DXF floor plan to 3D STL mesh
